02 / HOW I THINK

Automation with
intention.

The best workflow starts with understanding the work—and the people doing it.

01

Understand the process.

Start with the manual steps, bottlenecks, and exceptions. Make the problem clear before choosing the tools.

02

Build in good judgment.

Use AI where interpretation helps, explicit rules where accuracy matters, and human review where decisions need care.

03

Make it easy to trust.

Keep workflow states visible, document the logic, and distinguish a working integration from a demonstration.
